# PhotosDB golden fixtures

`original-photo-library.b64` is the Base64 representation of a 2,144-byte Photo
Database generated by the Original iOpenPod's photo writer. It contains one photo,
its full-resolution reference, two thumbnail references, the master Photo Library
album, one user album, and two file-format records. It was imported on 2026-09-14 as
the local compatibility baseline described by ADR-0004.

Decoded SHA-256:
`29b4e946b05945ac26d8782402b34bdad9ff16bb1a5691df9a10a9b747413b88`.

The encoded text form keeps the fixture reviewable and platform-neutral. Tests
decode it strictly before asserting complete byte equality.
